description: This file defines the class 'BarClusteredPlotAreaRenderer', a specialized renderer for clustered bar charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for calculating bar positions and sizes, and checking if data points are within a range.

classes.name: BarClusteredPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for clustered bar chart areas, drawing bars side by side and calculating their positions and sizes.

methods.name: CalcBars
methods.description: Calculates position, width, and height of each bar in all series for clustered bar charts.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Checks if a y-value is within the specified yMin and yMax range.
